name: Ookami Shounen to Usotsuki Shoujo
original_name: オオカミ少年と嘘つき少女
source:
The boy who cried wolf and the girl who lies have snuck into an empty classroom after graduation. That's how a contest of who's the bigger boaster had started. Should you trust anything they say?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7379]Freem![/url]]
